Class BoardFactory

java.lang.Object
model.factories.BoardFactory
public class BoardFactory extends Object
Factory class responsible for parsing the game board configuration from a JSON resource file and instantiating the corresponding domain model components based on the player count.

  • Method Details

    • createComponents

      public static BoardFactory.BoardComponents createComponents(int playerCount)
      Reads the board.json configuration file and constructs all necessary board components tailored to the specified number of participants.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - the number of players participating in the game session (expected range: 2 to 5)
      Returns:
      a BoardFactory.BoardComponents record encapsulating the instantiated tiles, slots, and assets
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the configuration file contains missing structural fields
      IllegalArgumentException - if no valid turn order configuration matches the given playerCount
      RuntimeException - if the JSON file cannot be found or read from the application resources

    • buildOfferTiles

      private static List<OfferTile> buildOfferTiles(com.google.gson.JsonArray array, int playerCount)
      Parses the JSON array containing offer tile definitions and filters them according to player count eligibility.
      Parameters:
      array - the JsonArray containing the raw offer tile data
      playerCount - the current game session's player count used as a lower-bound filter threshold
      Returns:
      a mutable List of instantiated OfferTile objects

    • buildTurnOrderData

      private static BoardFactory.TurnOrderData buildTurnOrderData(com.google.gson.JsonArray array, int playerCount)
      Scans the turn order configuration array to find the exact structural match for the specified player count.
      Parameters:
      array - the JsonArray containing configuration groups for various player counts
      playerCount - the exact number of players to match against the configuration groups
      Returns:
      a BoardFactory.TurnOrderData record holding the matching list of slots and asset metadata
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no layout group matches the specified playerCount
